description: Record a Japan regulatory/compliance check with full audit trail. Use this AFTER performing a regulation_check, foreign_entry_check, or any compliance-sensitive query. Creates an immutable, timestamped record for governance reporting. Agents operating under compliance requirements should call this after every regulatory lookup.

action.description: Action that was checked (e.g. 'open restaurant in Tokyo', 'apply for management visa')

compliant.description: Whether the action was found to be compliant

query.description: The original query/action that triggered the compliance check

result_summary.description: Summary of the compliance check result

name: compliance_log
